svg.title: Modeer Almalaaeb compact routes and endpoints
svg.desc: Routes for six core models plus Cup. Membership routes cover room players, groups, friends and cup rosters; Message covers room chat and direct messages. News uses an external API and no database model. Exact requests and permission rules are recorded in interfaces.json.
svg.text: Six core models + Cup · 42 HTTP operations · one authenticated WebSocket
News is external. Room slots and cup fixtures are embedded data; they have no separate endpoints.
HTTP method, FastAPI path and success status
Search safe player profiles for friends/invites
List nine activities and format presets
Create and open a scheduled room
Read authorized preview or full room
Edit, lock admission or transfer host
Cancel normally or in an emergency
Invite a user to group membership
Accept/decline, leave or remove group member
Invite accepted team members to cup roster
Read room/DM history or own DM inbox
Send room chat or direct message
Create social group or persistent team
Open registration, publish bracket, schedule/result or cancel
Fetch attributed sports news through server adapter
WS /api/v1/ws — Authorized room, DM and friend/group/cup invalidations
Create rooms directly. Scheduled start/end are automatic. Controllers share typed, authorized transactional services.
